description: Standardize clean temporary worktrees, minimal PR slices, branch naming, push policy, and subagent handoff expectations for noisy MCHS work.

support_scope.summary: Defines clean-worktree, branch, push, PR, CI, and subagent handoff policy. It does not rewrite existing PR history or resolve external reviewer gates.

gap_register.summary: Applying the policy to every existing dirty branch remains ongoing operational cleanup, not part of this policy-definition track.
